description: Vertical strip of a top-down pixel art fantasy world map: calm open ocean. Flat teal water in exactly the reference color, with only a handful of tiny short white wave dashes very widely scattered - the sea is mostly unbroken flat color. A thin chain of three tiny distant islands with pale sand rings in the upper half, then empty calm sea. No sparkle, no texture noise, no text, no borders.

reference_images.usage: west: the ocean immediately left of this strip; match its flat water color exactly
